evals.name: new-branch-publish-and-closeout
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Get this branch merged. There are local changes, no PR yet, and I want you to keep going unless you hit a real blocker." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The first merge invocation returns one terminal readiness handoff and ends. The caller invokes the standalone readiness coordinator separately, then starts a fresh merge invocation from live state. Each leaf runs once in its owning invocation; cleanup is routed through Versionkeeping, exact remote-ref deletion stops when its separate authorization is absent, and no deployment is invented.
expectations: The response starts from discovered repo and branch state instead of asking broad scope questions.
The agent discovers local policy before staging, committing, pushing, marking ready, resolving threads, or merging.
The absent-PR merge invocation returns a terminal readiness-handoff and ends without calling another lifecycle coordinator.
The caller invokes getting-prs-ready-for-review separately; it uses each Git publication, writer, and publisher leaf once and marks the PR ready only after current evidence passes.
After readiness succeeds, the caller starts a fresh getting-prs-merged invocation that rereads live state and credits each merge leaf once.
The agent stops rather than merging if required checks, approvals, ownership, or branch protection block merge.

After a verified merge, the agent routes cleanup through Versionkeeping, treats missing exact remote-ref deletion authorization as a cleanup gate rather than inventing it, and does not actuate deployment without a named repository owner.

evals.name: draft-pr-resume
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "PR #42 is already open as a draft. Mark it review-ready and drive it to merge." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The merge invocation returns a terminal readiness handoff for the draft PR and ends. The caller invokes standalone readiness, then starts a fresh merge invocation from live state.
expectations: The agent does not create a duplicate PR or replay completed publish work.
The first merge invocation returns a terminal readiness-handoff and does not call readiness itself.
A separate readiness invocation uses publishing-reviewable-prs with writing-reviewable-pr-descriptions before publishing readiness claims.
A fresh merge invocation uses complete feedback state and the canonical publisher audit for merge decisions.
The agent applies repo-local guidance before marking ready or merging.
The agent reports the next blocker if merge cannot proceed.

evals.name: review-comments-to-merge
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Address the unresolved review comments on this PR, rerun the review loop, and merge once it is clean." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The merge invocation acquires one complete read-only feedback snapshot, returns a terminal handoff to addressing-pr-review-feedback, and stops. The separate feedback invocation fixes and publishes independently safe work, stops at the maintainer-owned decision, and leaves the requested Tricritical loop and merge for later fresh invocations.
expectations: The merge invocation uses only the read-only feedback-acquisition leaf, returns exactly one addressing-pr-review-feedback handoff for actionable work, and stops.
The caller starts addressing-pr-review-feedback separately; no outcome coordinator calls another outcome coordinator.
The feedback invocation classifies comments, publishes independently safe fixes, refreshes state, and preserves ambiguous or human-owned decisions.
The feedback invocation does not start the requested fresh loop while a maintainer-owned product decision remains unresolved, and records the loop as still required before eventual merge.
Any later merge invocation rereads live state; the agent does not resolve threads when repo-local policy reserves resolution for another owner.

evals.name: local-policy-limits-autonomy
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Get this merged, but check the repo-local instructions first; this repo may require maintainer approval before resolving threads or merging." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The agent still uses the merge-closeout wrapper, discovers local policy before acting, follows any autonomy limits, and reports owner-controlled gates instead of forcing full autonomous closeout.
expectations: The agent treats local policy discovery as an early step, not a final afterthought.
The agent applies repo-local guidance to ready-for-review, thread resolution, merge method, branch cleanup, and deploy closeout.
The agent does not resolve threads or merge when local policy reserves those actions for another owner.
The agent reports the exact owner-controlled gate when full autonomy is not allowed.

evals.name: stalled-external-review
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Drive this PR to merge. It already had two completed bot review cycles, and the latest review has one stale-looking unresolved thread." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The agent refreshes complete feedback state, classifies the stale thread with evidence, and does not request another review loop unless review and revision are explicitly requested. The number of completed reviews creates no approval gate.
expectations: The agent does not immediately rerun the external reviewer.
The agent does not start a fresh tricritical:loop for this ordinary merge closeout.
The agent treats the current feedback state as the authority for the stale thread.
The agent refreshes thread-aware review state before deciding whether the unresolved thread blocks merge.
The agent does not infer a new approval requirement from the number of completed external reviews.
The agent routes an explicit review-and-revise request to tricritical:loop.

evals.name: pure-merge-current-state
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Merge this PR using its current review state. Do not request a new review unless the repository requires one." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The merge coordinator acquires current complete feedback through the read-only feedback-acquisition leaf, finds no actionable work requiring a handoff, does not start a fresh Tricritical loop, and merges only when all refreshed gates and merge authority pass.
expectations: The agent does not invoke tricritical:loop for ordinary merge closeout.
The agent obtains current complete feedback through the read-only feedback-acquisition capability without calling the feedback outcome coordinator.
The agent treats current complete feedback, checks, approvals, and mergeability as the merge gates.
The agent merges only after the current state and repository authority pass.

evals.name: coderabbit-skipped-review
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Get this PR merged. The latest checks are green, but CodeRabbit skipped review and branch protection still wants review." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not treat a skipped CodeRabbit check as completed review evidence; after local readiness and authority gates pass, it comments on the PR to request CodeRabbit explicitly, refreshes PR state, and merges only after approval and branch-protection gates pass.
expectations: The agent recognizes that a skipped CodeRabbit review is not a completed external review cycle.
The agent checks local readiness, current review authority, and any explicit operator or repository limits before requesting CodeRabbit again.
The agent requires explicit authority and uses an ordinary operation-specific top-level PR-comment actuator for the CodeRabbit request, not interacting-with-pr-review-feedback.
The agent requests CodeRabbit approval explicitly when approval is the only remaining gate after clean evidence.
The agent retains the comment actuator receipt and rereads the comment by ID or URL to verify PR, head, author, exact body, timestamp, and URL.
The agent refreshes PR state after CodeRabbit responds before merging.

evals.name: pr-description-only-near-miss
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Please just write a better PR description for this pull request." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper should not be used as the main workflow; the agent should use the PR-description skill to return a complete body, preserve the current title, and avoid merge-oriented actions. Publishing is required only when the request authorizes an actual PR-body update.

The agent narrows the task to PR body work, routes content to writing-reviewable-pr-descriptions, and preserves the current title byte-for-byte; a guarded publisher handoff is optional unless mutation is authorized.
The agent avoids implying merge readiness unless the user asks for closeout.

evals.name: explicit-review-loop-before-merge
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request: "Run a fresh review-and-revise cycle on this clean PR and merge it only after that cycle is clean." Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered action trace, gates checked, stop conditions, and final user-facing status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The merge-closeout invocation terminally hands the explicit fresh review-and-revise request to tricritical:loop and ends. After a bare clean result, a fresh merge-closeout invocation rereads live state and merges only after every gate passes.
expectations: The merge-closeout invocation terminally hands the explicit fresh cycle to tricritical:loop and ends.
The agent does not start the loop from addressing-pr-review-feedback, wrap Tricritical, or keep two loops active.
The agent stops on every non-clean terminal, including clean / degraded, because this request permits merge only after a bare clean cycle.
After a clean terminal, a fresh merge-closeout invocation rereads feedback, checks, approvals, base/head identity, and mergeability before merge actuation.
The agent merges only when the refreshed gates and repository authority permit it.

evals.name: gh-fix-ci-adapter-boundary
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, diagnose the failed required Actions job while preserving every unrelated PR and Git surface. Do not run live git or GitHub commands; write the ordered diagnostic trace, authority gate for any scoped source fix, forbidden actions, and final status you would produce.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the internal adapter to delegate Actions-only inspection and diagnosis to the updateable upstream github:gh-fix-ci skill, requires separate scoped authority before any source fix, and refuses PR text, readiness, comment, thread, merge, or ref mutation.
expectations: The agent limits upstream delegation to GitHub Actions inspection and diagnosis.
The agent requires separate explicit authority bound to owned paths before a scoped source or workflow fix.
The agent does not mutate PR text, readiness, comments, review threads, merge state, or Git refs.

evals.name: latest-publication-receipt-drift
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request. Do not use live Git or forge tools; give the exact publication-audit route, merge gate, and stopping status.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes the publisher's read-only audit before merge actuation, treats sequence 8 as authoritative, and blocks merge because the latest receipt drifts even though sequence 7 matches live state.
expectations: The response invokes audit_reviewable_pr.py audit through publishing-reviewable-prs with the exact current PR identity before merge actuation.
The response treats only sequence 8 as authoritative and explicitly rejects matching sequence 7 as merge evidence.
The response treats publication drift as a merge blocker even though checks, approvals, feedback, mergeability, and authority otherwise pass.
The response performs no merge, publication replay, ready mutation, retry, rollback, or reconciliation.
